purpose: All tracked LuCI Ucode and markup candidate paths at locked LuCI commit; source inventory and routing-policy projection only, no extraction or security claim.

selection_policy.source_selection: Unique tracked source path selected once if it has suffix .uc/.ucode/.ut; is a tracked .uc.in/.ucode.in generator input; is under package root/usr/share/rpcd/ucode; carries a recognized Ucode shebang anywhere; is extensionless inside a package ucode subtree, rpcd raw-mode tree, or root/usr/share/ucode; or has markup tag syntax inside a package ucode subtree or rpcd raw-mode tree. Generic extensionless htdocs assets are excluded absent Ucode evidence. This is a candidate superset, not an installed corpus count.
selection_policy.route_order_from_inspected_extractor: rpcd raw-mode installed path => plain; .ut => markup; ucode shebang => plain; markup tag => markup; .uc/.ucode => plain; remaining usr/share/ucode => uncertain; otherwise no route. Symlink targets are recorded but not followed.
selection_policy.source_to_installed_mapping: Inspected extractor `installed_path_for_source` maps applications/modules/protocols/themes `<package>/root/<tail>` to `<tail>` and `<package>/ucode/<tail>` to usr/share/ucode/luci/<tail>. `luci.mk` also documents root/ and ucode/ installation; libs category may not be recognized by extractor path mapper. htdocs maps through luci.mk to /www, but producer mapper does not map that source layout. Unmapped paths remain qualified. Extensionless htdocs files are candidates only with a recognized Ucode shebang. No htdocs static assets are retained solely because they are extensionless.
selection_policy.markup: Any `.ut` candidate is markup by suffix; content marker is checked after raw-mode and shebang and before `.uc` fallback. Classification is not evidence that markup is modeled.
selection_policy.generated: Tracked `.uc.in` / `.ucode.in` are generator inputs; generated installed files are not counted as tracked source candidates.
